title: Independently audit PR2917's paired-helper frame ledger
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/paired-helper-frame-ledger/`, a source-pinned independent **finite frame/accounting audit** of PR #2917. Its two inherited frame checks repeat essentially the same pivot-basis/climb implementation; this checker instead represents each frame by all its vectors in GF(2)^9 and reconstructs chronological paid events from the literal operations.

Both providers, all four parent/final words and nine extraction stages pass. The derived delta is **+9 H1 +18 H3 −18 H4**, with paid rank mass **5179 → 5170**, helper-width sum **3323 → 3314**, and private cleanup names **73 → 82**. All **13** frame refits equal old frame intersected with the extraction hyperplane. Reverting helper499's separate scale refit makes its later rank-eight touch illegal.

Intermediate stages are frame projections. Cleanup is checked as exact inverse-reverse syntax and buffer renaming. This does **not** prove compensation/operator endpoints, zero-buffer restoration, native implementation, allocation, physical stock, precision, outer admission or the retained all-size/compiler hypotheses. No new κ, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

- Picker: `independent-moment`, scope key `c6f2494b197df3bc3591`, priority revision 5; **refined** to PR2917's new nine-step input and distinct set-based rank method. [Task card](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5c6c32db4449aa661aca3c37416df0d7593908bd/research/paired-helper-frame-ledger/TASK.json).
- Entry main `8c8bcecb03def61bca701dd3b045932d39c48022`; refreshed publication base `4e8ceb80ecbc11049a44856b91f74a7448a75e93`. Guidance, catalogue and selected record are unchanged.
- PR2917 `224bd5e56041c40078ff6b5fa7393733a215de5c`; PR2908 `51309592971e3b5be935599eed2a95404dc7781e`; PR2894 `18d03c447886895ef9abf888398178e0428533ca`. Copied raw inputs match exact Git objects, including actual PR2908 WORD blobs matching carried PARENT blobs.
- [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18972911). This complements mdumitrean's active allocation work; no allocation search. Earlier independent audits #2847/#2865 concern different words; #2918 concerns helper408's fixed-cut rank-seven obstruction.
- Entry/fresh overlap covered 476/469 open PR bodies including drafts, local package notes/tasks/ledger, and relevant current Discussion claims. Non-atomic pagination, incomplete older Discussion coverage and unpublished work remain limitations.

## Validation

CPython **3.12.14**, macOS arm64; standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-helper-frame-ledger
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/paired-helper-frame-ledger --ref 5c6c32db4449aa661aca3c37416df0d7593908bd
```

Registered normal and optimized replays pass; **10 test groups pass in both modes**. Controls cover equal-rank wrong subspaces, chronology, invertible wrong warps, omitted terminal charges, reports, helper499's scale, cleanup aliases/inverses/types, transform binding, raw inputs and strict JSON. An independent pivot-rank oracle checks 128 small generating subsets, 16 subspaces and 256 containment pairs. A separate AI review also reproduced the section/mass calculation without importing this ledger or predecessor code.

`RESULT.json` stores deterministic receipts; `verify.py --details` emits freshly derived per-event ledgers. All **24 committed files** match validated local bytes; diff whitespace check passes. Selected baseline **bindings only** pass. Full selected/candidate supplier replays, formal/human review and hosted CI are not claimed.

Prepared by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI implementation, test and review agents. New work Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

The independently checked profile is an input to those obligations, not their completion.
